title: Correction to: Elevated CO2, warming and drought differentially impact reproductive and vegetative economic traits in two grassland species
content: This is a correction to: Murugash Manavalan, Dinesh Thakur, Andreas Schaumberger, Michael Bahn, Zuzana Münzbergová, Elevated CO2, warming and drought differentially impact reproductive and vegetative economic traits in two grassland species, Annals of Botany, Volume 137, Issue 3, March 2026, Pages 673–688, https://doi.org/10.1093/aob/mcaf214
